question: In Box: Add the tag design-review to the PDF in the Product Specs folder whose description mentions the mobile redesign, is under 2 MB, and has exactly 3 comments on it, not counting replies. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
No match. Here's what I found in **Product Specs**:

| File | Size | Description | Top-level comments |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Redesign Spec Addendum.pdf | 1.8 MB ✓ | "…mobile redesign of the navigation menu" ✓ | **2** ✗ (no replies) |
| Payment Redesign Spec.pdf | 3.0 MB ✗ | "…payment redesign flow" | — |

The mobile redesign PDF clears the description and size checks, but it only has **2 comments** (both top-level, none are replies) — not 3. So I did **not** add the `design-review` tag.
